meta.name: alterlab-bioservices
meta.description: Query 40+ bioinformatics web services through one consistent Python API with bioservices (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome, Ensembl, NCBI and more). Use when a workflow must hit multiple databases together, map identifiers across services, or run cross-database analyses — for quick single-database lookups use gget, for sequence and file manipulation use biopython. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 通过统一API查询40多个生物信息学数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Python中同时查询多个生物数据库（如UniProt、KEGG、NCBI等）
